bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: 127,000 views in a day. Everything you offer is free.
beats.text: Your latest video passed 127,000 views within a day, and The Daily Ninja reaches 80,000+ readers. But the newsletter says “always free”, and I couldn't find anything people can buy from you.

beats.title: You already promise to teach.
beats.text: Your second channel says “I want to teach you to do the same”, with 26,600 subscribers, and you post several videos a day. People follow you for the process, not just the news.

stats.label: on This Will Make You Rich

beats.title: They know what's coming. They don't have a plan.
beats.text: Every day your audience hears what's happening, and the only next step is tomorrow's free newsletter. The people who want help preparing their own finances have nowhere to go with you.

beats.title: “No get-rich-quick schemes.” This isn't one.
beats.text: A mentorship built on your own order, income first, leverage second, investing after, is the opposite of a get-rich-quick offer. The application keeps out anyone looking for a shortcut.
beats.quote: “No politics. No get-rich-quick schemes. No ‘just quit your job’ nonsense.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

mechanism.title: Income first. Leverage second. Investing after.
mechanism.body: Most people start with investing and skip the foundation. Travis' order starts with income you can grow, then using leverage carefully, then investing with cash reserves ready. In the mentorship you work through it step by step, in a small group.

qualification.title: Apply for the Economic Ninja mentorship

questions.q: Where are you financially right now?
options: Investing with a plan, want to improve it

questions.q: What do you want to work on?
What worries you most about the next 12 months?
Can you give it about an hour a week for 12 weeks?
Do you understand that investing involves risk and you can lose money?
If you're accepted, are you ready to invest in the mentorship now?

notFit.title: Thank you for being honest.
notFit.body: Right now the mentorship isn't the right next step for you. Stay with The Daily Ninja and the videos, and apply again when you're ready.

finalCta.title: Ready to have a plan instead of a worry?
finalCta.body: Apply here. One application, one call, a straight answer.
finalCta.disclaimer: Educational content only, not financial, tax or legal advice. All investing involves risk, including the possible loss of principal. Past performance does not guarantee future results. Individual results vary.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Have a rough idea of your income, savings, debts and any investments.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Travis

preCallEmails.subject: Income first, leverage second, investing after
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most people try to invest their way out before the foundation is there.

The mentorship goes in order: income, reserves, leverage, then investing.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Travis

preCallEmails.subject: "I already read the newsletter"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Good. Then you know what's happening.

The mentorship is where you decide what you do about it: twelve weeks, a small group and a written plan.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Travis

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Travis

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Travis's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Travis

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Travis
